user.title: Add an amaran fixture
user.description: Select an unprovisioned amaran fixture to add. The fixture must be powered on and not already paired in the Sidus Link app.

confirm.title: Provision {name}
confirm.description:
Home Assistant will provision {name} ({address}) into its own Bluetooth mesh network.

This removes the fixture from the Sidus Link app. To use the app again, factory-reset the fixture and re-add it there.

Keep the fixture powered on and close to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy while provisioning.

abort.already_configured: This fixture is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this fixture is already in progress.
abort.already_provisioned: This fixture is already joined to another Bluetooth mesh - the Sidus Link app, or a previous setup attempt that did not finish. amaran fixtures keep advertising as discoverable even when they are, so a factory reset is required before Home Assistant can adopt it.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the fixture. Move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter and try again.
abort.no_devices_found: No unprovisioned amaran fixtures found. Factory-reset the fixture so it advertises as unprovisioned, then retry.
abort.not_amaran: This Bluetooth mesh device is not a recognised amaran fixture.
abort.provisioning_failed: Provisioning failed. Factory-reset the fixture and try again.
